source_claim: The accepted anime character source, the official Young Jump Ren-taro Family profile, and a current Shueisha volume listing were checked; none established an exact safe relation for the current 12-member campaign.

checked_routes.result: The official anime character directory lists its currently named character entries through Kishika and did not explicitly identify a current campaign member among those entries.
The official Young Jump Ren-taro Family profile lists the first 20 members; none is an exact current campaign member.
Shueisha volume 26 metadata lists chapters including “百八先生は酒屋の娘,” but the displayed metadata does not give a full exact identity mapping to a current campaign member.

notes: The broad, ongoing Hyakkano authority campaign remains open. These routes add partial progress only; no residual is treated as absent or terminal.
